name: Return to Marleth
summary: Marleth waits in Brewnall Village for the Thunder Ale you bring from Kharanos. The barrel will prove her Scalder reached the Thunderbrew cellar.

sections.title: The Spoils of Sabotage
sections.body: The barrel comes from the Thunderbrew cellar, taken under the distillers’ noses. It proves the switch worked and gives Marleth a trophy from her rival.

sections.title: A Bitter Brew Settled
sections.body: You carry the heavy keg over snowy ridges to Brewnall Village. Marleth delights in outsmarting Kharanos’s guards and cellar masters. Her caper shows how fiercely dwarven families prize their signature recipes.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: You bring the stolen barrel of Thunder Ale to Marleth Barleybrew in Brewnall Village. It proves you planted her Scalder in the Kharanos cellar.
Marleth is a dwarven brewer in Brewnall Village. She takes pride in her family's stout recipes and rivals the Thunderbrew distillers in Kharanos.

faq.q: Where is the barrel brought from?
faq.answer: You take the barrel from the Thunderbrew Distillery cellar in Kharanos after swapping Marleth's Scalder into their stocks.
Brewnall Village lies on the frozen banks of Iceflow Lake in western Dun Morogh, northwest of Kharanos.

faq.q: Why is Marleth feuding with Kharanos?
faq.answer: Marleth wants to prove her Scalder can best or humiliate the celebrated Thunder Ale made by the Thunderbrews. Dwarven brewmasters compete fiercely over their recipes.

faq.q: What does Marleth do with the barrel?
faq.answer: The barrel proves the switch succeeded under the noses of the Kharanos guards. Marleth delights in keeping her rival's stock.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know brewing can be both an art and a contest of honor. Even cellar espionage can stir local pride.
As a rogue, you can test your stealth and sleight of hand by slipping into a guarded cellar and switching kegs in the snowy hills.
